description: Sends the SMS through kwtSMS to real phones and charges credits. Works only when the account owner switched live sending on (KWTSMS_MCP_ALLOW_LIVE) and requires confirm: true. The Sender ID is the one the owner set. Hourly and daily limits apply.

client_ref.description: Optional id for this send; a repeated id returns the first result and sends nothing

mobiles.description: Phone numbers in international format, for example 965XXXXXXXX

mode.description: Deprecated (0.1.x): preview and test map to preview_sms and send_test_sms

name: send_sms
title: Send SMS
